title: Arkret Directory Subject Handle List
description: Result body for ak.find.directory.read.list_handles_for_subject.v1. It lists currently visible handle claims for an exact disclosed holder AccountId in the caller's context. Every claim in claims[] MUST have subject_account_id byte-for-byte equal to this response account_id; proof DID URLs are verified independently through the registered method adapter.

account_id.description: Exact holder AccountId used as the reverse lookup key. Its principal and Station components both participate in equality; proof verification methods are resolved independently.

claims.description: Current context-visible signed handle claims. Each item MUST have subject_account_id equal to the top-level account_id; mismatches MUST be dropped or fail the response closed.

primary_handle.description: Optional canonical primary handle selected from claims[] by identity-handles.md section 3.2.1 for the same context/as_of. The @ mention sigil is not part of this field.

as_of.description: As-of timestamp used to build the visible claim set and primary handle selection.
